training_data.name: 130 schema-valid breakdowns (Unstuck task-breakdown SFT set)
training_data.quote: Each pair was distilled from a strong serverless model (`Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507` on Nebius Token Factory) prompted with Unstuck's real breakdown prompt across 44 tasks × 3 granularities (chunky / regular / tiny), then filtered through Unstuck's own validator — so every `completion` is on-contract: 1–12 steps, each a concrete imperative action, one category from `admin · creative · errand · deep-work`, and an integer minute estimate ≤ 25. Purely synthetic; no user data.

training_method.objective_quote: Unstuck — task-breakdown SFT set. 130 instruction→JSON pairs that teach a small model to break one overwhelming task into tiny, timed, categorised ADHD-friendly steps
training_method.update_scope_quote: Method: LoRA (r=16, α=32, dropout 0.05; q/k/v/o projections), 3 epochs, lr 2e-4, merged into the base.

description.text:
A tiny (0.5B) instruct model fine-tuned to turn one overwhelming task into **tiny, timed, categorised steps** in the exact JSON schema used by [Unstuck](https://huggingface.co/spaces/build-small-hackathon/unstuck) (HF Build Small Hackathon, Backyard AI track).

It powers Unstuck's `UNSTUCK_BACKEND=finetuned` path — a fully local, serverless-free option that runs the same `generate(prompt) -> str` seam as the app's other backends.

output_type.quote: A 0.5B model specialised for one narrow JSON task — it is not a general chat model.

use_claim.quote: Unstuck — Qwen2.5-0.5B fine-tuned for ADHD task breakdowns

warning.quote: A 0.5B model specialised for one narrow JSON task — it is not a general chat model. Outputs should still be schema-validated (the app does one repair retry on failure).

serving.text_only_input_quote: Feed it Unstuck's breakdown prompt (see unstuck.prompts.breakdown_prompt) and parse the JSON.
serving.system_prompt: You are Qwen, created by Alibaba Cloud. You are a helpful assistant.
serving.notes: Repo has merged model.safetensors and no adapter_config.json. The training script loads the base in bfloat16, not 4-bit or 8-bit, then merge_and_unload(). Chat template is the stock Qwen2.5-Instruct template. Safetensors parameter count is 494032768. Batch size 4 is in modal_finetune.py (batch = 4), not on the card.

evaluation_reported.text: Card and blog state final train loss ≈ 0.21. The blog says the tuned model produces schema-valid breakdowns at 60× fewer parameters than the teacher. The 12-task table in that blog is for Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, not this checkpoint.
